evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0001?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a connection pool exhaustion in checkout-service due to a misconfigured maximum connections parameter, which was set to 10 instead of 100. The engineering team isolated the source of the failure and implemented a configuration change to resolve the issue. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0002?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a Redis cache eviction triggered by the feature flag rollout, which resulted in unexpected authentication token validation path. Engineering team isolated the source of failure on feature-flags. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0003?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a payment gateway endpoint URL update during PCI compliance credential rotation, which resulted in a critical event disrupting operations on config-service. Engineering team isolated the source of failure on config-service and updated the URL. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0004?
evaluation_results.answer_text: The root cause was a CDN cache invalidation storm triggered by a bulk product catalog update, resulting in massive origin server load and search query latency. Engineering team isolated the source of failure on cdn-proxy, and the investigation progressed to isolate the origin server load. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0005?
evaluation_results.answer_text: Engineering team isolated the source of failure on notification-service. [EVD-001] [EVD-002]

evaluation_results.query: What was the root cause and resolution of incident INC-NS-0008?
